meta.basis: Capitalised value per m2 of gross floor area, 2026 dollars, before construction cost. Each row keeps its market inputs so the value can be recomputed (see core/validate_data.js). Order-of-magnitude only.

methods.sale: price_ft2 x 10.764 x efficiency x (1 - selling_cost)
methods.income: rent_ft2_yr x 10.764 x (1 - vacancy) x (1 - leakage) x (1 - opex_ratio) - opex_ft2_yr x 10.764, / cap_rate x efficiency (monthly rent x 12)
methods.visitors: visitors x ticket x (1 + fnb_uplift) x margin / cap_rate / deck_area_m2
methods.per_stall_income: rate_month x 12 x utilisation x margin / cap_rate / m2_per_stall
methods.stated: value given directly; no inputs to recompute
methods.none: earns nothing (public or support); cost only

meta.value_basis: sourced = the pack's original row, built from cited market inputs and the pack author's stated assumptions; typical = a typical estimate added so every programme has a number, by analogy with a sourced row or from a quick 2025-26 search. Typical values are grade C: check before relying on them.
